whatsNew.title: What's new

intro.title: Make Musclog your own
intro.description: A few things have changed. Take a quick look and choose what works for you. Changes save as you tap; you can revisit this tour in Settings.
intro.truncated: We’ve kept this tour to the latest highlights.

whatsNew.saveFailed: Couldn’t save this choice. Please try again.
whatsNew.dismissFailed: Couldn’t save your progress. Please try again.

settingsCard.title: What's new
settingsCard.subtitle: Revisit the latest features and preferences

view.title: Your workout, your view
view.description: Guided view now helps you focus on one set at a time. Prefer the full picture? Inline view is still here.

workoutView.title: Choose your workout view
workoutView.description: You can change this later in visual settings.

guided.label: Guided
guided.description: Focus on your current set with larger controls.

inline.label: Inline
inline.description: See and edit your sets together in a list.

targets.title: A little help with your next set
targets.description: Musclog suggests starting targets from your history. Changed numbers are marked, and you can always edit them.

workoutAutonomy.title: Starting targets
workoutAutonomy.description: How your history shapes the next workout.

suggest.label: Suggest targets
suggest.description: Use progression suggestions when starting a workout.

manual.label: Keep my plan
manual.description: Start with the targets saved in my workout.

progressionMode.title: Progression preference
progressionMode.description: What goes up first when targets change.

reps_first.label: Reps first
reps_first.description: Build up repetitions before adding weight.

rest.title: Rest without watching the clock
rest.description: Your rest timer can start automatically after a set. Choose whether you want it to vibrate, too.

autoStartRestTimer.title: Start rest automatically
autoStartRestTimer.description: Start the rest timer when you complete a set.

restTimerHaptics.title: Rest timer vibrations
restTimerHaptics.description: Use haptic feedback for the rest timer.

gyms.title: Targets that fit your gym
gyms.description: Add your gym’s equipment, bar weight and available plates. Musclog can use them for loadable targets and plate calculations.

review.title: One weekly moment to reflect
review.description: Weekly Review brings your nutrition and training together, with suggestions you choose whether to apply.

reviewWeekday.title: Your review day
reviewWeekday.description: Pick a day that fits your routine. Existing reminder preferences stay in place.

plans.label: Workout plans
plans.description: Organize workouts into weekly or rotating plans.

cardio.label: Cardio log
cardio.description: Record cardio sessions alongside your strength training.

swaps.label: Exercise swaps
swaps.description: Swap an exercise during a workout without changing the original plan.

restrictions.label: Exercise restrictions
restrictions.description: Remember exercises to avoid and temporary injuries in workout settings.

warmups.label: Warm-up sets
warmups.description: Keep warm-ups separate from your working sets.

widgets.title: Widgets on both platforms
widgets.description: Nutrition Progress and Smart Camera now support iOS and follow your app theme and language. On iOS, touch and hold the Home Screen, choose Add Widget, then Musclog.

migration.title: Re-add your Android widgets
migration.description: Remove your old Musclog widgets and add Nutrition Progress or Smart Camera again from your launcher’s widget picker.

menus.title: Calmer menus and Settings
menus.description: Menus and Settings are now simple grouped lists instead of stacks of cards, and Settings is organized into seven clearer groups.

home.title: A tidier Home screen
home.description: Home opens on today’s numbers with the date on top and smaller shortcut tiles. The Weekly Review card appears only while a review is due.

cycleDiary.title: A private, encrypted cycle diary
cycleDiary.description: Your periods, day logs and context are now stored encrypted on your device. Predictions show how confident they are, and a fertile-window estimate is optional and off by default.

cycleReminders.title: Reminders and a Cycle widget
cycleReminders.description: Choose how much a reminder says, from fully discreet to detailed, and add the new read-only Cycle widget. With an app lock on, the widget shows nothing personal.

cycleLock.title: Lock just your cycle
cycleLock.description: In Settings → App lock you can now protect your cycle, workouts, nutrition, progress, or the whole app behind your device credential.

heatmaps.title: Your activity at a glance
heatmaps.description: See the days you trained and the days you logged meals as a calendar of squares on Home. Darker squares are busier days. Tap a square, or hover on web, to read out that day.

layouts.title: Three ways to show them
layouts.description: Full width shows about four months of each heatmap, one above the other. Side by side puts both in one row as two small cards with the last 30 days. Compact squeezes them into a single short card with a thin 30-day row for each.

setup.title: Off until you turn them on
setup.description: Go to Settings → Appearance and home → Home heatmaps to show workouts, nutrition, or both, and pick the layout. With only one heatmap on, it always uses the full width.
